limitations: A voltage configured in ampere mode is a decoder/energy input, not a sampled VIN voltage.
Textual historic VALIDATION claims at 3300 mV are retained as documentary claims; no independent meter result or explicit dated operator confirmation was located in the inspected source sessions.
Only representative gzip CSV headers were read (one per category per module); current existence and byte size were checked for all authoritative RAW. No fresh CRC/continuity claim is made.

No .bin/.ppk/.ppk2 or calibration-named files exist in these six source session trees; accepted metadata has no calibration coefficients. Coefficients embedded elsewhere outside the inspected session trees are not ruled out.

notes: Ampere mode and external VIN-to-VOUT guard are documented; these establish measurement mode, not an independently observed supply voltage.

The log text input voltage=3300 mV originates from the configured voltage argument. No instrument voltage readback or operator confirmation linked to these historical captures was found in the two source sessions and exported campaign logs.
